does_not_cover: No named test statistic appears: no z, t, chi-square, or rank procedure is ever computed.
Multiple testing and false-discovery control are absent despite many repeated probability comparisons.
Coin enumeration with 4 or 32 outcomes teaches nothing about power or sample-size planning for real studies.
notes: Long repetitive delivery from doubled captions; flower and drug analogies carry the intuition. Binomial counting underneath is discrete-distribution craft: teaches knowledge-sad-l07-bernoulli-binomial — reassignment signal.
